paragraphs.text: A Planeswalker's Guide to Zendikar is the second installment in the Planeswalker's Guide series, offering an in-depth look at the Zendikar setting for Magic: The Gathering . Unlike the first guide, it was released entirely as a series of online articles on DailyMTG.com beginning September 9, 2009, detailing the plane's geography, peoples, and the chaotic phenomenon known as the Roil .
In contrast to its predecessor it is not a printed book; instead it is comprised of a web series of articles on DailyMTG.com . The first article went online September 9, 2009.
